WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess_share
  FROM status_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess_share) AS average_share_excess
FROM above_average;
